scenes.setting: The blast's aftermath: Capim, Parker and the servants charred dead; Harras — blistering toward loss of control — Exiles the specter and flees without a backward glance at Katy, whom a final Air Bullet releases from her pain
scenes.text_anchor: The bullet struck Katy in the head, ending her pain.

scenes.setting: The basement: Belize fires his high-pressure steam rifle once and bolts; Air Bullets shatter the Confinement, and an invisible specter runs down both rows of cells throwing iron doors open — Daisy and the girls flee the burning villa toward freedom
scenes.text_anchor: as though an invisible specter was running to unlock them

scenes.setting: From the street the girls look back: atop the evil building stands an imposing figure in full black armor and crown, cape fluttering silently — and, mistrusting the police, they run for a cathedral
scenes.text_anchor: It was clad in full black armor, and it wore a black crown.

scenes.setting: Curtain call staging: a sweep for clues yields only a tarot deck — the Major Arcana scattered over Capim's corpse, with 'Judgment' and 'The Emperor' laid face-up over the trafficker's eyes
scenes.text_anchor: he covered Capim’s eyes with the two tarot cards he had specially drawn

scenes.setting: Two demigods converge: Cardinal Ace Snake, Spellsinger of God, and a golden-eyed handsome man who 'lives nearby'; they read the tarot tableau on Capim — then spot the black-crowned figure on a rooftop, who nods, lifts his cape, and vanishes under their noses
scenes.text_anchor: the “Judgment” card which depicted an Angel blowing a great trumpet, and “The Emperor” card
